tokens.name: crust
tokens.usage: Deepest surface. Player stage behind video, drop zones, and the text colour on accent fills in Mocha (`on-accent`). In Latte it is a light chrome tint, never a text colour.

tokens.name: mantle
tokens.usage: Chrome surface: sidebar, title bar, popovers, dialogs. Text on it: `text` (12.14:1 Mocha, 6.57:1 Latte) or `subtext1` (9.91 / 5.14).

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: App background and the main content ground. `text` 11.34:1 in Mocha, 7.06:1 in Latte; `subtext1` 9.26 / 5.53.

tokens.name: surface0
tokens.usage: Cards, hover rows, hairline dividers. Put `text` on it (8.69:1 Mocha, 5.17:1 Latte); `subtext1` drops to 4.05:1 in Latte, so secondary text on cards uses `text`.

tokens.name: surface1
tokens.usage: Input fill, pressed rows, track of progress bars. `text` on it is 6.31:1 in Mocha but 4.39:1 in Latte: keep text on `input` short and in `text`, never in `subtext`.

tokens.name: surface2
tokens.usage: Strong dividers, unselected toggles, relief blocks. Decorative: not a text ground.

tokens.name: overlay0
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder marks. Mocha 3.36:1 on base; Latte only 2.30:1, so in Latte it is decorative and never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: overlay1
tokens.usage: Quiet icons and secondary glyphs in Mocha (4.44:1 on base). Latte 2.83:1: decorative only.

tokens.name: overlay2
tokens.usage: Buffered ranges and quiet icons. Mocha 5.81:1 on base; Latte 3.49:1 (passes 3:1 for marks, not for text).

tokens.name: subtext0
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions on `background` and `sidebar` in Mocha (7.37:1). In Latte it misses 4.5:1 on base (4.37:1): the source pair is kept exact; `muted-foreground` switches to `subtext1` in Latte for that reason.

tokens.name: subtext1
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`: 9.26:1 Mocha, 5.53:1 Latte on base. On `card` in Latte it is 4.05:1: use `text` there.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`, `card`: at least 8.69:1 in Mocha and 5.17:1 in Latte.

tokens.name: rosewater
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative fill or tag colour. Not text in Latte (2.34:1 on base).

tokens.name: flamingo
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative fill or tag colour. Not text in Latte (2.64:1 on base).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Optional accent and cover-tint colour. Not text in Latte (2.34:1 on base).

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: The default accent (`accent` aliases it). Mocha 8.07:1 on base, Latte 4.79:1; works as text and as a mark on `background`, `sidebar`, `card`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (`danger` aliases it). Mocha 7.08:1, Latte 4.80:1 on base: allowed as text on `background` and `sidebar`.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative; Latte 3.48:1 on base (marks only, not text).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warnings (`warning` aliases it). Mocha 9.27:1; Latte 2.64:1 on base, so always pair with an icon and a word set in `text`.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Ratings, highlights, 'new' dots. Mocha 12.91:1; Latte 2.31:1, so never the only carrier of meaning and never text in Latte.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success and completed states (`success` aliases it). Mocha 11.03:1; Latte 2.96:1, just under 3:1 for marks: pair with an icon and a word set in `text`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Optional accent; downloaded/offline marker. Latte 3.31:1 on base (marks only).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Latte 2.47:1 on base (decorative).

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Info and queued states (`info` aliases it). Mocha 8.69:1; Latte 2.78:1: pair with an icon and a word set in `text`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links and optional accent. Mocha 7.79:1; Latte 4.34:1 on base (just under 4.5:1 as text).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Optional accent and secondary highlight. Mocha 9.17:1; Latte 2.81:1 on base (decorative).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Text on it: `foreground`, `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icon colour on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`, `card`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (metadata, timestamps, helper copy) on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover` only. 7.37:1 in Mocha, 5.53:1 in Latte on base. On `card` use `foreground`.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar, title bar and top/bottom bars outside the player.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Episode rows, source rows, queue items, stat tiles. Text on it is `foreground`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control. Inside a `card` use `input` for lines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, checkboxes and unselected controls. At least 3:1 on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover` (Mocha 3.36:1, Latte 3.49:1 on base). Place controls on those grounds, not on `card`.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, sliders' track, hovered rows.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav marker, selection, focus ring (solid 2px) and seek/progress fill. At least 3:1 on `background`, `sidebar`, `card` in both themes (Mocha 6.19-8.07, Latte 3.51-4.79). Swapping the accent is a user setting: change only this alias.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills. Crust in Mocha (9.23:1 on mauve), base in Latte (4.79:1 on mauve). Valid for mauve and the other dark-enough accents; check the palette notes before using it on a pastel Latte accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Downloaded, watched, verified. Always an icon plus a word in `foreground`; the colour only reinforces it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low disk space, retrying, unverified repository. Always an icon plus a word in `foreground`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed download, stream error, destructive buttons. Icon plus word; text allowed on `background`/`sidebar`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Queued, syncing, informational notices. Icon plus word in `foreground`.

tokens.name: video-stage
tokens.usage: Stage behind the video and the letterbox, identical in both themes. Never light.

tokens.name: video-scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent top and bottom player bars (85% crust) over the picture, identical in both themes. Text and icons on it use `video-text`; the bars carry a 1px `video-track` hairline.

tokens.name: video-text
tokens.usage: Time, titles and icons in the player chrome (12.97:1 on `video-stage`).

tokens.name: video-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the player chrome, such as episode name and quality (8.42:1 on `video-stage`).

tokens.name: video-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled seek and volume track. The `video-buffered` fill is 3.23:1 against it.

tokens.name: video-buffered
tokens.usage: Buffered range on the seek bar, drawn between `video-track` and `video-accent`.

tokens.name: video-accent
tokens.usage: Played range, thumb, active control and focus ring inside the player, 9.23:1 on `video-stage`.

tokens.name: video-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `video-accent` fills in the player (9.23:1).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Anime title in the detail header, dialog titles.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings, settings group titles, episode names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up on the same episode next time.

styles.name: mono-time
styles.usage: Playback time and duration in the player, always in tabular figures.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: File sizes, speeds, ETA, segment counts in Downloads.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between grid cells.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Toolbar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large gaps in empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Custom title bar height (drag region, back/forward, search, status, window controls).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: sidebar-w-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar width.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Player top bar height.

tokens.name: bottombar-h
tokens.usage: Player bottom bar height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small items: menu rows, pills inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search field, covers' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, cover tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, round icon buttons, progress tracks, count pills.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers floating over content.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and the command palette.
